# Device routes are deny-by-default for protected processes. Every allow below is
# exact, counted and risk-bearing. Merge reviewed rows above this deny and above
# the broad device deny in the main policy. First match wins, and each row spends
# one use, so keep the counts in step with the requests the client really makes.
#
# A control row (value=0x........) covers only that control. Opening the device is
# itself decided, with value=0x00000000, so a device needs the open row as well as
# its control row; a control row alone leaves the open denied.
#
# Device paths are the canonical ObQueryNameString name the driver logs in the
# event, never a \GLOBAL??\ScsiN: link: ScsiN: resolves to \Device\RaidPortN on
# storport or to \Device\Scsi\PortN on scsiport. Copy the path from the denial
# event or from `kfilterctl watch`; {adapter-GUID} and HID#device-instance are
# placeholders for the same reason.
#
# allow|device|\Device\MountPointManager|value=0x00000000|uses=1|risk=mount-point-open
# allow|device|\Device\MountPointManager|value=0x006D0008|uses=1|risk=volume-ids
# allow|device|\Device\RaidPort0|value=0x00000000|uses=1|risk=storage-adapter-open
# allow|device|\Device\RaidPort0|value=0x0004100C|uses=1|risk=storage-adapter-data
# allow|device|\Device\{adapter-GUID}|value=0x00000000|uses=1|risk=adapter-open
# allow|device|\Device\{adapter-GUID}|value=0x00170002|uses=1|risk=adapter-mac
# allow|device|\Device\HID#device-instance|uses=1|risk=hid-device-id
deny|device|\Device

# Risk-bearing replacements for the two MachineIdLib lines in the main policy.
allow|file|\Device\HarddiskVolume3\Nexon\Library\maplestorycw\appdata\MachineIdLib.dll|rights=read|uses=2|risk=machine-id-library
allow|file|\Device\HarddiskVolume3\Nexon\Library\maplestorycw\appdata\MachineIdLib.dll|rights=read,execute|uses=1|risk=machine-id-library

# Flag only; kfilter cannot block or track these channels:
# SMBIOS firmware tables, the machine SID in the process token, and CPUID.
